thesis: The episode argues that the primary investment opportunity in AI lies not in models but in applications, distribution, and infrastructure that drive growth through product cycles. It posits that AI unlocks value by enabling humans to do less work while generating more economic value, a trend evidenced by rapid enterprise adoption and the integration of AI into daily routines.
